THE SPIRIT OF KOMOREBI

Simple things.
Done beautifully.

Lomorebi is the Japanese word for sunlight filtering through trees. Fleeting, gentle, and
quietly beautiful. That is the feeling we want to bring to your table.

A warm bowl after along day. The first bite of something new. A table full of people you
love. Our kitchen is built around these small, good moments.

A little care in every plate.

MEET THE CHEF

Cooking with
quiet confidence.

Chef Haru believes Japanese cooking is less about adding more and more about knowing what to
leave alone. His menu is guided by season, texture, balance, and the pleasure of sharing food.
